claim: A routine that uses SP as a data pointer breaks coroutine yields, mid-blit snapshots and stack low-water measurement unless handled.

evidence.text: A loop using SP as data pointer yields without CALL: save SP and live registers.
A mid-blit snapshot with SP as a graphics pointer needs a bounded native prelude.
The eraser uses SP as a pointer, so the stack low-water measurement is unreliable.
the render walks object lists and ROM bytes by POP, so an interrupt push during a 3.5 MHz calibration render overwrites its data; the handler puts the 2 bytes back from genuine memory
evidence.quote: It POPs ROM bytes as data (SP pages 0x00-0x16)
